The published post is always a reshare authored by your account with the original embedded underneath. With content, your text is the commentary (LinkedIn's "repost with your thoughts"); with no content it publishes as a text-free reshare.

A text-free reshare is NOT LinkedIn's one-click "Repost" (the feed treatment where the original author stays the author). LinkedIn's API exposes no way to create that, so the post still appears authored by you with the original embedded.

poll.description: Create a LinkedIn poll with this post. Cannot be combined with media or reshareUrl. Polls cannot be edited after publishing on LinkedIn, and API-created polls are non-sponsored only (they cannot be promoted as ads).

options.description: Poll options (2-4 choices, max 30 characters each)

duration.description: How long the poll accepts votes. Defaults to SEVEN_DAYS.

LinkedInPlatformData.description:
LinkedIn post options.

- Media: up to 20 images, no multi-video. A single PDF is supported (max 100MB). Link previews are auto-generated when no media is attached.
- Use organizationUrn for multi-org posting.
- Geo-restriction only works for organization pages (not personal profiles) and requires the targeted audience to exceed 300 followers.
- Polls, via the poll object: 2-4 options, cannot be combined with media or reshareUrl, cannot be edited after publishing. API-created polls are non-sponsored only.

title.description: Pin title. Defaults to first line of content or "Pin". Must be ≤ 100 characters.

boardId.description: Target Pinterest board ID. If omitted, the first available board is used.

boardSectionId.description: Target section inside the board. Optional; the pin lands on the board itself when omitted. Pinterest rejects the pin if the section does not belong to boardId, so send both together.

coverImageUrl.description: Optional cover image for video pins

coverImageKeyFrameTime.description: Optional key frame time in seconds for derived video cover

isAiGenerated.description: When true, the Pin is created with Pinterest's AI_MODIFIED disclosure (ai_disclosures), which shows an "AI modified" label. Applies to image and video Pins. Pinterest offers no "not AI" value, so false omits the disclosure. Pinterest may still label a Pin on its own detection.

title.description: Video title. Defaults to first line of content or "Untitled Video". Must be ≤ 100 characters.

visibility.description: Video visibility: public (default, anyone can watch), unlisted (link only), private (invite only)

madeForKids.description: COPPA compliance flag. Set true for child-directed content (restricts comments, notifications, ad targeting). Defaults to false. YouTube may block views if not explicitly set.

firstComment.description: Optional first comment to post immediately after video upload. Up to 10,000 characters (YouTube's comment limit).

containsSyntheticMedia.description: AI-generated content disclosure. Set true if the video contains synthetic content that could be mistaken for real. YouTube may add a label.

notifySubscribers.description: Set false to skip notifying subscribers about this upload (YouTube's notifySubscribers). Defaults to true.

categoryId.description: YouTube video category ID. Defaults to 22 (People & Blogs). Common: 1 (Film), 2 (Autos), 10 (Music), 15 (Pets), 17 (Sports), 20 (Gaming), 23 (Comedy), 24 (Entertainment), 25 (News), 26 (Howto), 27 (Education), 28 (Science & Tech).

playlistId.description: Optional YouTube playlist ID to add the video to after upload (e.g. 'PLxxxxxxxxxxxxx'). Use GET /v1/accounts/{id}/youtube-playlists to list available playlists. Works for both immediate and scheduled uploads. Quota cost: 50 YouTube API units per call.

YouTubePlatformData.description:
YouTube video settings.

- YouTube publishes a vertical or square video of 3 minutes or less as a Short; there is no flag.
- Custom thumbnails work for regular videos only.
- Scheduled videos are uploaded immediately with the specified visibility.
- There is no description field here: the description comes from the post content, or from customContent on this platform target when set, truncated to 5000 characters.

locationId.description: Target Google Business Profile location ID (e.g. "locations/123456789"). If omitted, uses the default location. Use GET /v1/accounts/{id}/gmb-locations to list locations.

languageCode.description: BCP 47 language code (e.g. "en", "de", "es"). Auto-detected if omitted. Set explicitly for short or mixed-language posts.

topicType.description: Post type. STANDARD is a regular update. EVENT requires the event object. OFFER requires the offer object. Defaults to STANDARD if omitted.

callToAction.description: Optional call-to-action button displayed on the post

type.description: Button action type: LEARN_MORE, BOOK, ORDER, SHOP, SIGN_UP, CALL

url.description: Destination URL for the CTA button (required when callToAction is provided)

event.description: Event details. Required when topicType is EVENT. Google returns 400 if omitted for EVENT posts.

title.description: Event name (displayed as the event heading on Google Search and Maps)

schedule.description: Event date/time range. Uses Google's date format (NOT ISO 8601).

startDate.description: Event start date as { year, month, day }

startTime.description: Optional start time as { hours, minutes } in 24h format

endDate.description: Event end date as { year, month, day }

endTime.description: Optional end time as { hours, minutes } in 24h format

offer.description: Offer details. Required when topicType is OFFER. All fields are optional per Google's API, but at least one is recommended.

redeemOnlineUrl.description: URL where the offer can be redeemed online

termsConditions.description: Terms and conditions for the offer

GoogleBusinessPlatformData.description: Text and single image only (no videos). Supports STANDARD, EVENT, OFFER, and ALERT post types. Posts appear on Google Business Profile, Google Search, and Maps. Use locationId for multi-location posting. Schedule dates accept both ISO 8601 strings (e.g. '2026-04-15T09:00:00Z') and Google's native {year, month, day} objects.

TikTokPlatformData.description:
Photo carousels up to 35 images. Video titles up to 2200 chars, photo titles truncated to 90 chars.
privacyLevel must match creator_info options. Both camelCase and snake_case accepted.

Creator Inbox (draft mode): Set draft: true to send content to the TikTok Creator Inbox
instead of publishing immediately. The creator receives an inbox notification and completes
the post using TikTok's editing flow. This maps to TikTok's post_mode: "MEDIA_UPLOAD" internally.

Important: The field publish_type is NOT supported. Use draft: true for Creator Inbox flow.

Photo drafts use the /v2/post/publish/content/init/ endpoint with post_mode: "MEDIA_UPLOAD".
Video drafts use the dedicated /v2/post/publish/inbox/video/init/ endpoint.

When draft: true, the video.upload scope is required. When draft is false or omitted
(direct post), the video.publish scope is required. For Creator Inbox, TikTok app version
must be 31.8 or higher.

draft.description:
When true, sends the post to the TikTok Creator Inbox as a draft instead of publishing immediately. The creator gets an inbox notification to complete posting via TikTok's editing flow.

- true: maps to TikTok API post_mode: "MEDIA_UPLOAD" (photos) or the dedicated inbox endpoint (videos).
- false or omitted: publishes directly via post_mode: "DIRECT_POST".

publish_type is not a supported field; use this field instead.

privacyLevel.description: One of the values returned by the TikTok creator info API for the account. Accounts connected through the TikTok for Business app publish videos as public only: a non-public value on a video post is rejected at creation unless draft is true (photo posts keep every level).

commercialContentType.description:
Type of commercial content disclosure. Sufficient on its own: "brand_organic"
("Your Brand") implies isBrandOrganicPost and "brand_content" ("Branded Content",
paid partnership) implies brandPartnerPromote, so you don't need to send the
boolean flags separately. Branded content cannot be posted with privacyLevel
SELF_ONLY.

brandPartnerPromote.description:
Whether the post promotes a brand partner (branded content / paid partnership).
Only needed to disclose BOTH types at once (set it alongside
commercialContentType "brand_organic"), or to override the value implied by
commercialContentType.

isBrandOrganicPost.description:
Whether the post promotes the creator's own brand (brand organic). Only needed
to disclose BOTH types at once (set it alongside commercialContentType
"brand_content"), or to override the value implied by commercialContentType.

contentPreviewConfirmed.description: User has confirmed they previewed the content

expressConsentGiven.description: User has given express consent for posting

mediaType.description: Optional override. Defaults based on provided media items.

videoCoverTimestampMs.description: Optional for video posts. Timestamp in milliseconds to select which frame to use as thumbnail (defaults to 1000ms/1 second). Ignored when videoCoverImageUrl is provided.

videoCoverImageUrl.description:
Optional for video posts. URL of a custom thumbnail image (JPG, PNG, or WebP, max 20MB). Any downloadable URL works: we rehost it ourselves. Overrides videoCoverTimestampMs when provided.

The image is stitched as a single frame at the start of the video to serve as the cover. Accounts connected through the TikTok for Business app instead hand it to TikTok as the cover, with no stitching, falling back to videoCoverTimestampMs without it.

photoCoverIndex.description: Optional for photo carousels. Index of image to use as cover, 0-based (defaults to 0/first image).

autoAddMusic.description: When true, TikTok may add recommended music (photos only). With the brand-organic or branded-content toggle on, TikTok allows Commercial Music Library tracks only, so this attaches nothing there; use musicSoundInfo instead.

musicSoundInfo.description: Commercial Music Library track to attach. Accounts connected through the TikTok for Business app only: a developer-app account rejects the post at publish time with a message that says so. Pick musicSoundId from GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/tiktok/commercial-music. Ignored on drafts, where TikTok ignores every post_info field.

musicSoundId.description: The clip.id of a track from GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/tiktok/commercial-music (its id publishes too, but viewers may see the sound as unavailable in their country; observed from Germany). TikTok fails the publish with a generic 51065 when given the commercial music id instead.

musicSoundVolume.description: Track volume. TikTok defaults an omitted volume to 0, which publishes the track silently, so we default to the app's 50. Video posts only.

musicSoundStart.description: Start point of the track in milliseconds (default 0). Video posts only.

musicSoundEnd.description: End point of the track in milliseconds (default: the video length). Must be greater than musicSoundStart. Video posts only.

videoOriginalSoundVolume.description: Volume of the video's own sound when a commercial track is attached (0 to 100). Requires musicSoundInfo. Video posts only. Omitted, TikTok keeps its API default of 0 and the video's own audio is muted under the track (the TikTok app uses 50).

videoMadeWithAi.description:
Set true to disclose AI-generated content.

Accounts connected through the TikTok for Business app carry the disclosure on video posts only. The business photo endpoint has no AI disclosure field, so true on a direct photo post is rejected at creation rather than published undisclosed.

To publish such a photo post, send draft true and set the disclosure in the TikTok app.

locationId.description:
Location tag to attach, as the id of a result from GET /v1/accounts/{accountId}/tiktok/locations. Requires locationName. Ignored on drafts, where TikTok ignores every post_info field.

Accounts connected through the TikTok for Business app and video posts only:

- A developer-app account rejects the post at publish time with a message that says so.
- A direct photo post is rejected at creation, since the business photo endpoint has no location field.

locationName.description: Display name of the location tag, as returned next to its id. Required with locationId; a locationId without it is rejected at creation.

isAdsOnly.description: Set true to publish the video as an "Only show in ads" post: it is kept off the profile and exists to be used as a Spark Ad. Accounts connected through the TikTok for Business app and video posts only, with the same rejections as locationId. Ignored on drafts.

description.description: Optional long-form caption for photo posts (max 4000 chars). Recommended when content exceeds 90 chars, as photo titles are auto-truncated. Falls back to the post content when omitted.

parseMode.description: Text formatting mode for the message (default is HTML)

disableWebPagePreview.description: Disable link preview generation for URLs in the message

disableNotification.description: Send the message silently (users will receive notification without sound)

protectContent.description: Protect message content from forwarding and saving

TelegramPlatformData.description: Text, images (up to 10), videos (up to 10), and mixed media albums. Captions up to 1024 chars for media, 4096 for text-only.

contentType.description: Content type: story (ephemeral 24h, default), saved_story (permanent on Public Profile), spotlight (video feed)

SnapchatPlatformData.description: Requires a Public Profile. Single media item only. Content types: story (ephemeral 24h), saved_story (permanent, title max 45 chars), spotlight (video, max 160 chars).

subreddit.description: Target subreddit name (without "r/" prefix). Overrides the default. Use GET /v1/accounts/{id}/reddit-subreddits to list options.

title.description: Post title. Defaults to the first line of content, truncated to 300 characters.

url.description: URL for link posts. If provided (and forceSelf is not true), creates a link post instead of a text post.

forceSelf.description: When true, creates a text-only self post and skips native media uploads, even when media is provided. For native video with body text, omit forceSelf and supply content plus a video mediaItem.

flairId.description: Flair ID for the post. Required by some subreddits. Use GET /v1/accounts/{id}/reddit-flairs?subreddit=name to list flairs.

flairText.description: Custom flair text, for subreddits that allow free-text flair. Ignored when flairId is provided (flairId wins).

nsfw.description: Mark the post as NSFW (Not Safe For Work / over 18).

spoiler.description: Mark the post as a spoiler. The subreddit must have spoiler tagging enabled for this to take effect.

sendreplies.description: Whether to receive inbox replies for comments on this post. Set to false to opt out.

nativeVideo.description:
Controls Reddit's native video upload flow. When true (default for video mediaItems), the video is uploaded to Reddit's CDN and submitted with kind=video, so it renders as an embedded Reddit video player. Reddit transcodes server-side (1080p/30fps cap). Set to false to explicitly publish an external link instead.

The post content (or Reddit customContent override) is included as Markdown body text on the native video.

When body text is present, upload failures or subreddit video restrictions fail the post without falling back to a link. Automatic link fallback applies only without body text.

videogif.description: When true (and nativeVideo is active), submits the video as a silent videogif (kind=videogif). Use for short looping clips without audio.

videoPosterUrl.description: Optional poster/thumbnail image URL for native video posts. If omitted, the first frame of the video is extracted and used automatically.

RedditPlatformData.description: Posts are either link (with URL/media), native video (via nativeVideo), or self (text-only). Use forceSelf to override. Subreddit defaults to the account's configured one. Some subreddits require a flair.

langs.description:
Language(s) of the post text as 1-3 BCP-47 codes (e.g. "pt", "en-US"), written to the post record's langs field. Bluesky feed generators filter on it, so posts without it never appear in language-scoped feeds.

- Can only be set at creation (Bluesky has no post editing).
- With threadItems, every item in the thread carries the same langs.
- When omitted, the account's default (set via PATCH /v1/accounts/{accountId}/bluesky-settings) applies. With no default either, the field is absent from the record.

threadItems.description: Complete sequence of posts in a Bluesky thread. The first item becomes the root post, subsequent items are chained as replies. When threadItems is provided, the top-level content field is used only for display and search purposes, it is NOT published. You must include your first post as threadItems[0].

BlueskyPlatformData.description: Bluesky post settings. Supports text posts with up to 4 images or a single video. threadItems creates a reply chain (Bluesky thread). Images exceeding 1MB are automatically compressed. Alt text supported via mediaItem properties. Use langs to tag post language for feed-generator filtering.

channelId.description: Target channel snowflake ID. Determines which channel in the connected server receives the message.

embeds.description: Up to 10 Discord embed objects (combined max 6,000 characters across all embeds). Sent alongside or instead of plain-text content.

color.description: Embed accent color as decimal integer (e.g. 5814783 for blue). Convert hex to decimal.

poll.description: Native Discord poll. Cannot be combined with media attachments in the same message.

allow_multiselect.description: Allow users to select multiple answers. Default false.

crosspost.description: Auto-crosspost to every server following this announcement channel (type 5). No-op for regular text channels.

forumThreadName.description: Thread title for forum channel posts (type 15). Required when posting to a forum channel.

forumAppliedTags.description: Tag snowflake IDs to apply to forum posts. Max 5 tags.

threadFromMessage.description: Create a follow-up thread under the published message.

tts.description: Send as text-to-speech message. Discord reads the message aloud in the channel.

webhookUsername.description: Override the webhook display name for this post only (1-80 chars). Falls back to the account-level default set via PATCH /v1/connect/discord.

webhookAvatarUrl.description: Override the webhook avatar URL for this post only. Falls back to the account-level default.

DiscordPlatformData.description:
Discord message settings.

- Content: plain text (2,000 chars), rich embeds (up to 10), native polls, forum posts, threads, and announcement crossposts.
- Media: images (JPEG, PNG, GIF, WebP), videos (MP4), and documents (up to 10 files, 25 MB each).
- Webhook identity (username + avatar): customize per account via PATCH /v1/connect/discord, or per post via webhookUsername/webhookAvatarUrl.

threadTs.description: Parent message ts to post this message as a thread reply (e.g. "1503435956.000247").

unfurlLinks.description: Expand links in the message into preview cards. Default true.

unfurlMedia.description: Expand media links into inline previews. Default true.

username.description: Override the bot display name for this message only (requires no setup; shown with an APP badge). Does not change the app identity in the sidebar.

iconUrl.description: Override the bot avatar image URL for this message only.

SlackPlatformData.description:
Slack message settings. Posts mrkdwn text (up to 40,000 chars; Slack truncates beyond that) to the channel fixed by the connected account. Up to 10 media files per post are uploaded via Slack's file API (the text becomes the caption).

The channel is chosen at connect time (one connected account per channel), so channelId is NOT accepted here (400). Connect the desired channel via /v1/connect/slack and target its accountId.

Messages over 4,000 characters cannot be edited later (Slack's edit limit is stricter than its post limit).

RecyclingConfig.description:
Automatic post recycling (reposting at regular intervals). After the post is published, the system creates new scheduled copies at the specified interval until expiration conditions are met.

- Weekly or monthly intervals.
- Maximum 10 active recycling posts per account.
- YouTube and TikTok are excluded.
- Content variations are recommended for X and Pinterest to avoid duplicate flags.

enabled.description: Set to false to disable recycling on this post

gap.description: Number of interval units between each repost. Required when enabling recycling.

gapFreq.description: Interval unit for the gap. Defaults to 'month'.

startDate.description: When to start the recycling cycle. Defaults to the post's scheduledFor date.

expireCount.description: Stop recycling after this many copies have been created. Send null on update to clear this limit.

expireDate.description: Stop recycling after this date, regardless of count. Send null on update to clear this limit.

contentVariations.description:
Content variations for recycled copies. Each recycle uses the next variation, in round-robin order. Recommended for X and Pinterest to avoid duplicate content flags.

- If omitted, the original post content is used for all recycled copies.
- Send an empty array [] to clear existing variations.
- Must have 2+ entries when setting variations.
- Platform-level customContent still overrides the base content per platform.

canPublish.description: True only when every evaluated TikTok account can publish now

tiktok.description: One verdict per `tiktok` entry in the request, in request order

alreadyPostedToday.description: Whether this account already published a Direct Post today (an account that did can keep publishing). Absent for Creator Inbox drafts and when no per-user limit applies.

warnings.description: Advisory notices about a post that was still created: media truncated for a platform, a recycling caveat, or a field that was ignored because it sat outside platforms[].platformSpecificData. Absent when there are none.

title.description: Stored on the post for reference/display only. This field is NOT used as the video title when publishing. To set a YouTube video title, use platformSpecificData.title on the youtube platform target (falls back to the first line of content when omitted).

status.description: `cancelled` is set by POST /v1/posts/{postId}/unpublish once every platform entry has been removed from its platform (a post with published entries left becomes `partial`); cancelled posts can be edited and rescheduled like drafts. `pending_approval` (set by `requiresApproval: true`) never publishes until POST /v1/posts/{postId}/review approves it.

tags.description: YouTube constraints: each tag max 100 chars, combined max 500 chars, duplicates removed.

hashtags.description: Stored for reference only. Hashtags are NOT automatically appended to the caption when publishing. Include hashtags directly in the content field (platforms like Instagram only support hashtags as caption text). For YouTube keywords, use the tags field instead.

mentions.description: Stored for reference only. This field does NOT automatically create @mentions when publishing. For LinkedIn @mentions, write them in the post content, for example @[https://www.linkedin.com/in/jane-doe] or @[https://www.linkedin.com/company/acme].

recycledFromPostId.description: ID of the original post if this post was created via recycling

queuedFromProfile.description: Profile ID if the post was scheduled via the queue

queueId.description: Queue ID if the post was scheduled via a specific queue

updatedAt.description: Last change to the post or to any of its platforms (a publish, a failure, a resolved URL).

disabledResourceGroups.description: Resource groups turned off for this team member. Empty for owners and unrestricted members.

platform.description: Supported values: twitter, threads, instagram, youtube, facebook, linkedin, pinterest, reddit, tiktok, bluesky, googlebusiness, telegram

customContent.description: Platform-specific text override. When set, this content is used instead of the top-level post content for this platform. Useful for tailoring captions per platform (e.g. keeping tweets under 280 characters).

scheduledFor.description: Optional per-platform scheduled time override (uses post.scheduledFor when omitted)

platformSpecificData.description:
The platform-specific options stored on this target, echoed back as sent.

Typed per platform on the way in (see the *PlatformData schemas on the request body); free-form on the way out. A response is not guaranteed to match exactly one variant, and generated clients that pick a variant by structure reject the entire response when it doesn't.

Zernio's internal publishing state (snapshots, container ids, publish stage) is never returned here. The key is omitted rather than sent as an empty object.

status.description: Platform-specific status: pending, processing, uploading, published, failed, cancelled (removed from the platform via POST /v1/posts/{postId}/unpublish)

platformPostId.description: The native post ID on the platform (populated after successful publish)

platformPostUrl.description:
Public URL of the published post. Included in the response for immediate posts; for scheduled posts, fetch via GET /v1/posts/{postId} after publish time.

Empty when the platform confirmed the publish without returning an id a permalink can be built from (TikTok returns a publish id for some uploads). The TikTok reconcile cron backfills it later. If TikTok never returns one, /v1/analytics reports that entry as syncStatus unavailable.

publishedAt.description: Timestamp when the post was published to this platform. YouTube uploads a scheduled public video up to 15 minutes early as private with YouTube's own release time, so its entry is published with this set to scheduledFor, the moment the video goes public.

removedFromPlatformAt.description:
Set when a successfully published post later disappears from the platform (deleted on-platform or taken down by the platform). Absent while the post is live, and cleared if it reappears.

status stays "published" (it reflects the publish outcome), so poll this field to detect post-publish removals. Detection runs with the analytics sync: expect up to a few hours of lag.

isTrialReel.description:
Present and true only when this Instagram reel was launched as a Trial through Zernio (created with platformSpecificData.trialParams). Use it to segment trial reels in analytics.

Instagram's Graph API exposes no readable trial field, so this reflects creation-time intent only: the reel STARTED as a trial, not whether or when it graduated.

trialGraduationStrategy.description: Graduation strategy the trial reel was launched with. Present only when isTrialReel is true.

publishAttempts.description: Number of times the publishing pipeline claimed this target to publish it since it was created or last manually retried (a manual retry resets it, except on TikTok). Not the number of retries (see publishRetries).

publishRetries.description:
Instagram only. Automatic re-sends of media_publish on the same container that Zernio scheduled after Meta answered a transient error: 30 min, 2 h and 6 h after each failure, at most 3. Absent when none was scheduled.

While the target is still processing, the latest one may not have been sent yet. Not reset by a manual retry. Independent of publishAttempts, which counts publish-leg claims.

errorMessage.description:
Human-readable reason this target has not published yet, or why it failed.

- Failed entries: why the publish failed, with the platform's error details.
- Pending entries: why the publish has not gone out yet, for example the last temporary error while Zernio retries the publish automatically, or a posting limit notice.

A posting limit holds the post with the notice "This post is queued and will publish automatically after <timestamp>".

The limits are the hourly posting velocity limit and, on a TikTok account connected through the TikTok for Business app, the daily cap of 15 videos and 15 photo posts.

A held post keeps status pending and its scheduledFor moves to that timestamp. It is not failed.

errorCategory.description:
Error category for programmatic handling:

- `auth_expired`: token expired/revoked
- `user_content`: wrong format/too long
- `user_abuse`: rate limits/spam
- `account_issue`: config problems
- `platform_rejected`: policy violation
- `platform_error`: 5xx/maintenance
- `platform_rate_limit`: platform throttling, retried automatically
- `quota_exhausted`: a shared quota pool the integration draws on is empty, including our own capacity gate in front of one. Not caused by your content or account, and safe to retry once the pool frees up.
- `system_error`: Zernio infra
- `unknown`

errorSource.description: Who caused the error: user (fix content/reconnect), platform (outage/API change), system (Zernio issue, rare)

PostPlatformError.description:
The platform's own error for this target, so you can see what the platform said (access tokens are redacted). errorMessage stays the human-readable summary; this block is for diagnostics and support tickets.

**Lifecycle**: set when the last attempt failed with an error the platform described (currently Instagram and Facebook). Kept while an automatic retry of that failure is pending or running; cleared when the target publishes or is retried manually.

**Instagram**:

- Media processing failures carry no code or subcode, only Meta's status text in message.
- On a publish whose outcome is uncertain (for example errorMessage starting "Instagram did not confirm"), carries the last media_publish error Meta returned, when it returned one. errorMessage stays the verdict, so do not read this block as a confirmed failure.

code.description: Meta error code, when Meta sent one.

subcode.description: Meta error_subcode, when Meta sent one.

message.description: The platform's raw error message or media processing status text.

RecyclingState.description: Current recycling configuration and state on a post

gap.description: Number of interval units between reposts

contentVariations.description: Content variations for recycled copies (if configured)

contentVariationIndex.description: Current position in the content variations rotation (read-only)

recycleCount.description: How many recycled copies have been created so far (read-only)

nextRecycleAt.description: When the next recycled copy will be created (read-only)

lastRecycledAt.description: When the last recycled copy was created (read-only)

PostPublishIncompleteResponse.description: Body of the 207 returned by createPost and updatePost when the post was saved but the inline publish did not fully succeed. Read `post.status` to tell the three outcomes apart.

message.description: Human-readable summary of the publish outcome.

error.description: Present when no platform published. Absent on a partial success. Informational only; the per-platform detail is in `platformResults` and in `post.platforms[]`.

platformResults.description: Per-platform outcome of the publish attempt. Omitted when the attempt aborted before producing per-platform results (for example the post was already being processed); read `post.platforms[]` in that case.

status.description: Per-platform status: pending, processing, published, failed, cancelled, uploading.

error.description: Failure detail for this platform, or null when it did not fail.

warnings.description: Advisory notices about the post that was still created. Absent when there are none.

LinkedInMentionIssue.description: One LinkedIn mention that could not be resolved, listed under `details.mentions[]` of the error.

input.description: The mention exactly as written in the request, for example `@[https://www.linkedin.com/in/jane-doe]`.

nextCursor.description: Cursor for the next page in the same sortBy order. Send it back as `cursor`. Null on the last page, and always null for `sortBy=status` or `sortBy=platform`. Absent for `source=external`.

latePostId.description: Original Zernio post ID if scheduled via Zernio

status.description:
Overall post status. "partial" when some platforms published and others failed.

While any platform is still pending or processing, the post's own status is returned instead (usually scheduled or publishing), even if another platform already published.

A post with no published or failed platform (for example every platform cancelled) returns its own status with syncStatus unavailable and no platformAnalytics.

syncStatus.description: Overall sync state across all platforms

message.description: Human-readable status message for pending, partial, or failed states

thumbnailUrl.description: Cover image URL. Facebook and Instagram covers whose Meta CDN link expired are re-read from Meta and served from Zernio storage, so that URL does not expire and can be cached.

mediaItems.description:
All media items for this post. Carousel posts have one entry per slide.

- Facebook and Instagram images and video covers whose Meta CDN links expired are re-read and served from Zernio storage (non-expiring).
- Facebook and Instagram video file URLs, and LinkedIn media URLs, stay the platform's signed links and are refreshed on read once they lapse.

url.description: 'Direct URL to the media file. Null when the platform withholds it: check mediaStatus before downloading. Instagram omits the video file for Reels it flags as containing copyrighted material (its docs name audio as the usual cause), so type stays "video" while the file is permanently unreachable.'

thumbnail.description: Thumbnail URL (same as url for images). Still present when url is null.

altText.description: Accessibility alt text set on the media, when present.

mediaStatus.description: unavailable means the media file could not be retrieved (url is null or, for LinkedIn videos, a cover image standing in for the file). available or absent means the file is available at url (older synced items omit the field).

unavailableReason.description: Why the file is missing. platform_withheld means the platform declined to return it and retrying will not help.

mediaProductType.description: Instagram only: the platform media product type (e.g. FEED, REELS, STORY, AD). Absent when the platform did not report it.

isAiGenerated.description: Instagram only: whether Instagram labeled the media as AI-generated. Absent when the platform did not report it.

isSharedToFeed.description: Instagram reels only: whether the reel is also shared to the main feed. Absent when the platform did not report it.

mediaAudioType.description: Instagram only: audio type of the media (MUSIC or ORIGINAL_SOUND). Absent when the platform did not report it.

clicks.description: Link clicks where the platform reports them. Always 0 on Facebook Page stories: Meta exposes no link-click metric for stories.

follows.description:
Accounts that started following from this post.

- Reported for Instagram feed posts and stories (organic follows), Facebook Reels (Meta post_video_followers) and the TikTok business lane.
- Null on Instagram Reels and non-Reels video, and on Facebook posts that are not Reels, where Meta does not expose this metric for the media.
- 0 for other platforms.

igReelsAvgWatchTime.description: Average watch time per play, in milliseconds, for Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels and TikTok videos (business accounts). On Facebook it includes replays within a play, so it can exceed the Reel length. 0 for other media and platforms, including regular Facebook videos.

igReelsVideoViewTotalTime.description: Total watch time including replays, in milliseconds, for Instagram Reels, Facebook Reels and TikTok videos (business accounts). 0 for other media and platforms, including regular Facebook videos.

reelsSkipRate.description:
Instagram Reels only: percentage (0-100) of initial views that skipped the reel within its first 3 seconds, as reported by Meta.

- Meta labels the metric estimated and in development, so it can move between syncs.
- 0 for non-Reels media and other platforms.
- For a post published to several accounts, the aggregate is weighted by views.

completionRate.description:
Share of viewers who watched the video to the end, 0 to 1, as TikTok reports it. Only for TikTok accounts connected through the TikTok for Business app.

- Delayed T+24-48h, and only for posts active in the last 7 days.
- 0 for other platforms.
- For a post published to several accounts, the aggregate is weighted by views.

profileViews.description: Instagram feed posts (images and carousels; 0 on Reels and Stories) and TikTok accounts connected through the TikTok for Business app: profile views from users who reached the profile through this post (TikTok T+24-48h). 0 for other platforms.

websiteClicks.description: TikTok accounts connected through the TikTok for Business app only: clicks on the profile website link attributed to this post (T+24-48h). Also counted inside `clicks`, which sums every profile-link type (website, phone, email, address, app download). 0 for other platforms.

impressionSources.description:
Share of views by surface, as fractions 0 to 1. Only for TikTok accounts connected through the TikTok for Business app (T+24-48h, only for posts active in the last 7 days).

- Keys: `forYou`, `follow`, `search`, `personalProfile`, `sound`, `directMessage`, `other`. A surface TikTok adds later appears under a camelCase key derived from its name.
- Empty object when TikTok reports nothing, and for other platforms.
- When a post is published to several accounts, each share is weighted by views.

audienceTypes.description:
TikTok accounts connected through the TikTok for Business app only: two viewer splits as fractions 0 to 1 (T+24-48h).

- Each pair sums to 1 when present: `follower` + `nonFollower`, and `newViewer` + `returnViewer`. TikTok can report one pair without the other.
- Empty object when TikTok reports nothing, and for other platforms.
- Views-weighted across accounts, like impressionSources.

audienceCountries.description:
TikTok accounts connected through the TikTok for Business app only: share of views by viewer country, as fractions 0 to 1, keyed by upper-case ISO-3166 alpha-2 code. Available T+24-48h, only for posts active in the last 7 days.

At most 20 country keys plus `other`. The catch-all bucket TikTok sends, any country below 0.001 and anything past the twentieth all sum into `other`, so the values still add up to 1.

Empty object when TikTok reports nothing, and for other platforms. Views-weighted across accounts like impressionSources.

replays.description: Facebook Reels only: plays that were replays (Meta fb_reels_replay_count). Summed across accounts. 0 for other media and platforms.

retentionCurve.description:
Facebook Reels and TikTok business lane: share of viewers still watching at each second of playback, as fractions 0 to 1. Keys are whole seconds from the start of a play ("3" is the share still watching at 3 s). Empty object for other media and platforms.

- Facebook Reels (Meta post_video_retention_graph): the base is a subset of plays that Meta selects and does not expose. On small Reels it can be far below views (6 of 51 measured), so a value is a share of that subset, not of all plays.
- Facebook Reels length: loops count as continued playback, so a short Reel's curve runs past its length (an 8 s Reel has keys "0" to "12"). Meta returns at most 41 points, so a long Reel covers only its first 40 s.
- TikTok accounts connected through the TikTok for Business app (TikTok video_view_retention): one point per whole second, at most 61 points, thinned evenly on videos longer than 60 s.

On a cross-posted post this is the curve of the account with the most views among those reporting one, never a blend: curves from different platforms and accounts measure different audiences and different seconds. Each platformAnalytics entry keeps its own curve.

reposts.description:
Reposts of the media by other users, minus deleted reposts, on feed posts, reels and stories. Instagram accounts connected with Facebook Login only.

- Instagram Login accounts: always 0 (Meta does not expose this metric for them).
- Other platforms: 0, including Threads, where reposts are counted in shares instead.

videoDurationSeconds.description:
Video length in seconds. Null when unknown: platforms that do not report a length, non-video media, or when Instagram does not expose the media URL (e.g. reels with copyrighted audio).

- YouTube: filled for public videos once their analytics next refresh (from the Data API; live streams may report null). The Data API has no Shorts flag: a video over 180 seconds cannot be a Short, but a shorter one may be a regular upload.
- Instagram Reels: also filled. Combine with igReelsAvgWatchTime (ms) to estimate retention.

engagementRate.description:
Percentage, rounded to 2 decimals: (likes + comments + shares + saves) / (impressions or reach or views) * 100. Clicks and follows are never counted.

The denominator is the FIRST of impressions, reach, views that is non-zero, so the basis varies by post: impressions if present, else reach, else views. For a single consistent basis (e.g. interactions / reach), compute it from the raw fields above.

On the post-level roll-up of a cross-posted post, the denominator is the SUM of the denominators resolved per platform entry. An entry reporting none of impressions, reach or views is excluded from both sides of the ratio. Each platformAnalytics entry below keeps its own single denominator.

The engagementRate on the LinkedIn account endpoints uses a different formula.

platformPostId.description: The native post ID on the platform (e.g. Instagram media ID, tweet ID)

syncStatus.description: Sync state of analytics for this platform

errorMessage.description:
Failure detail:

- Failed entries: why the post failed to publish.
- Unavailable entries: why analytics cannot be synced (e.g. Google Business Profile, a TikTok upload that never received a video id).
- Pending entries: the most recent analytics sync error for the account (null while no sync has failed), cleared after the next successful sync.

errorCode.description:
Stable machine-readable reason for errorMessage. New values may be added.

- post_not_found: the post was deleted or is no longer visible to the account.
- not_post_owner: the post is owned by another Page or user (collab or visitor post); its analytics cannot be read with this Page's token.
- permission_missing: the last analytics sync of the Facebook account failed because the Page no longer grants pages_read_engagement (pending entries only).
- null: no stable code; read errorMessage.

isOwner.description: Facebook only: true when the connected Page authored the post, false when Facebook reports another author (a collab post), null when unknown or for other platforms.

latePostId.description: Original Zernio post ID if scheduled via Zernio

isAd.description:
True when this post's metrics include paid delivery, so organic reporting should exclude it.

Set for LinkedIn dark posts and for TikTok posts one of your TikTok ads promotes (Spark / boosted).

TikTok exposes no ad flag of its own. A video created by an uploaded-asset (non-Spark) TikTok ad is posted to the profile with a fresh organic id and cannot be detected, so those still report false.

thumbnailUrl.description: Cover image URL. Facebook and Instagram covers whose Meta CDN link expired are re-read from Meta and served from Zernio storage, so that URL does not expire and can be cached.

mediaItems.description:
All media items for this post. Carousel posts contain one entry per slide.

- Facebook and Instagram images and video covers whose Meta CDN links expired are re-read and served from Zernio storage (non-expiring).
- Facebook and Instagram video file URLs, and LinkedIn media URLs, stay the platform's signed links and are refreshed on read once they lapse.

thumbnail.description: Thumbnail URL (same as url for images)

altText.description: Accessibility alt text set on the media, when present.

mediaProductType.description: Instagram only: the platform media product type (e.g. FEED, REELS, STORY, AD). Absent when the platform did not report it.

isAiGenerated.description: Instagram only: whether Instagram labeled the media as AI-generated. Absent when the platform did not report it.

isSharedToFeed.description: Instagram reels only: whether the reel is also shared to the main feed. Absent when the platform did not report it.

mediaAudioType.description: Instagram only: audio type of the media (MUSIC or ORIGINAL_SOUND). Absent when the platform did not report it.

accounts.description: Connected accounts (followerCount and followersLastUpdated only included if user has analytics add-on)

hasAnalyticsAccess.description: Whether user has analytics add-on access

staleAccountCount.description: Number of accounts with stale analytics data

syncTriggered.description: Whether a background sync was triggered for stale accounts

Unauthorized.description: Missing or invalid API key. `code` is `missing_credentials` when no Authorization header was sent and `invalid_credentials` when the key is unknown, revoked or expired.

example.error: Missing API key. Send it as Authorization: Bearer <your API key>.

TemporarilyUnavailable.description: An upstream service or database is temporarily unavailable. Retry after the indicated delay. A timed-out write may have completed upstream; check its outcome before resubmitting.

Retry-After.description: Minimum delay in seconds before retrying.

example.error: Temporary connection issue while reaching an upstream service. Please retry the request.

AccountUnavailable.description: The account or requested resource was not found or is not accessible. An account ID may have been disconnected and removed. Read GET /v1/accounts for current account IDs.

example.error: Account ID not found. It may have been disconnected and removed. Read GET /v1/accounts for current account IDs.

AccountConnectionRequired.description: The account exists but is inactive or needs reconnection. Reconnect it, then read GET /v1/accounts for its current account ID before retrying. Code: ads_connection_required.

example.error: This account needs reconnection. Reconnect the account, then read GET /v1/accounts for its current account ID before retrying.

RateLimited.description:
The connected account's upstream platform quota is exhausted. Behavior per platform:

- **Reddit:** rate-limits per connected Reddit user (1000 requests per 10-minute window), shared by every operation on that account. Retry after the window resets; repeated calls while exhausted do not succeed and keep the budget spent.
- **Google Ads:** writes and reports run on one developer token shared by every Google Ads account on Zernio. It holds Standard access (no daily operations cap), so this only happens when Google throttles the token or your ad account.
- **Google Ads envelope:** `code: rate_limited`, `platform: google`, `details.quotaScope: DEVELOPER` (`ACCOUNT` when it is your own ad account's quota), `details.resetsAt` (ISO instant when Google accepts requests again) and `Retry-After` counting down to it. Retrying earlier cannot succeed.
- **YouTube Analytics:** reads (channel-insights, demographics, daily-views, video-retention) use the "Queries per day" quota of the Google Cloud project the account is connected through, shared with other Zernio customers, so a 429 is not your own volume. Resets at midnight Pacific Time.
- **YouTube Analytics envelope:** `code: rate_limited`, `platform: google`, `details.quotaExhausted: true`, `details.quotaScope: DEVELOPER`, `details.resetsAt` and `Retry-After` counting down to it. Retrying earlier cannot succeed.
- **Meta ads:** every Meta throttle (codes 4, 17, 32, 613 and business-use-case codes 80000-80014) returns 429 `rate_limited`, even when Meta answers HTTP 400. `Retry-After` comes from Meta's `x-business-use-case-usage` estimate when sent, else Meta's 60-second minimum (30 seconds for the one-write-per-30-seconds limit on one object).
- **Pinterest ads:** limits per user and app, per category (ads_read, ads_write, ads_analytics). `Retry-After` comes from Pinterest's `x-ratelimit-reset` when sent, otherwise 60 seconds.
- **TikTok ads:** limits per app and per endpoint (per second, minute and day), answering overage with code 40100 or code 40002 `OVER_QPS_LIMIT`. Both return 429 `rate_limited` with `platform: tiktok` and `Retry-After: 10`. Space out bulk reads (e.g. one ad at a time per advertiser) instead of retrying at once.

**TikTok Smart+ review read** (`GET /v1/ads/{adId}/tiktok-smart-plus-review`) has its own stricter TikTok quota. After an overage, Zernio answers 429 for that advertiser and connection without calling TikTok for about 60 seconds, then 120, up to 240 while TikTok keeps refusing, each with up to 10% random jitter.

A successful call holds nothing back; the next overage pauses about 60 seconds again. `Retry-After` is the time left. The advertiser-wide read (`GET /v1/ads/tiktok-smart-plus-reviews`) answers 200 with `retryAfterSeconds` and `refreshState` instead. Keep one request in flight per advertiser there.

Retry-After.description: Seconds remaining until the upstream quota resets.

connectToken.name: X-Connect-Token
connectToken.description:
Short-lived connect token for API users during OAuth flows. 
Automatically generated when initiating OAuth without a browser session.
Valid for 15 minutes. Connect tokens are scoped to the intended profile
and platform and are accepted only by connection-flow endpoints that
explicitly list this security scheme.
